pages.text: MaidSpell normally restricts friendly fire. This compatibility removes that restriction so allied maids can be affected. It is implemented with a Mixin and cannot be disabled in this mod's config.

Click a Maidify Crystal with a Starlight Dagger in your inventory to enhance it once; the dagger is not consumed and the crystal gains a special tooltip.$(br2)Collision damage caused by ragdolls created with an enhanced crystal is treated as player damage.

An ordinary Maidify Crystal cannot transform the Stellar Witch Wine Fox, and attacking her with maid-to-ragdoll items also fails, producing special dialogue.$(br2)After enhancement, the crystal can always target her, forces the Stellar Witch model and changes the boss bar style while battle mode is active.

When the Stellar Witch is defeated, if she accumulated more than 300 damage (150 hearts) from ragdoll collisions during the fight, she is considered to have been crushed to death.$(br2)This unlocks the hidden advancement “i Fox's Territory”, awards a Dream Cat Crystal and plays unique defeat dialogue.
